changes.source:
投手の球種にはそれぞれ球威が設定されています
球威が高いと次のような効果があります。
１：変化するポイントがより打者寄りになる。
２：打撃ポイントのサイズが小さくなる。
３：ストレート系があまり減速しなくなる。
changes.previous_english:
Each pitch has its own Stuff rating.
Higher Stuff makes breaking pitches break
later, closer to the batter. It also makes
the Pitch Marker smaller and helps fastballs
retain more of their speed.
changes.english:
Each pitch has its own Pitch Power rating.
Higher ratings make breaking pitches break
later, closer to the batter. They also make
the Pitch Marker smaller and help fastballs
retain more speed.

changes.source:
球種・投手と打者の利き腕・投法・コース。
この組み合わせでボールは色々な姿を見せます。
キッチリとコースに決めると球威が上がるのが、
コースミスすると下がるのが見えるので色々試し
て自分だけの投球スタイルを作ってみて下さい。
changes.previous_english:
Pitch type, handedness, delivery, and location
all affect how the ball looks to the batter.
Hitting your spot improves Stuff; missing
it reduces Stuff. Experiment to develop
your own pitching style.
changes.english:
Pitch type, both players' handedness, delivery
and location affect how the ball looks.
Accurate location improves Pitch Power;
missing lowers it. Experiment to find
your own pitching style.

changes.source:
打撃（投球）ポイントとはストライクゾーン上に
表示されるボールをイメージしたポイントです。
このポイントは球種ごとに動きが異なります。
また、球威によって大きさが変わり、打ちやすさ
が変わってきます。
changes.previous_english:
The Pitch Marker represents the incoming
ball within the strike zone. Its movement
depends on pitch type, and its size changes
with Stuff, affecting how hard it is to hit.
changes.english:
The Pitch Marker represents the incoming
ball within the strike zone. Its movement
depends on pitch type; Pitch Power changes
its size and how hard the pitch is to hit.

changes.source:
投球しようとする目標とリリースタイミングを教
えてくれる投球カーソル。
これが小さくなった瞬間にリリースすれば、ベス
トピッチとなって球威が大幅に上がるぞ。
changes.previous_english:
The pitching cursor shows your target and
release timing. Release when it shrinks to
its smallest point for a Best Pitch,
which gives Stuff a large boost.
changes.english:
The pitching cursor shows your target and
release timing. Release when it reaches
its smallest size for a Best Pitch,
which greatly boosts Pitch Power.

changes.source:
プロスピでは<×>を２回押して投球します。
１回目：押すと投球を開始します。
２回目：リリースのタイミングに押します。
この時、タイミングがよいと球威のある球を投げ
ることができます。
changes.previous_english:
Press <×> twice to pitch.
First press: start the delivery.
Second press: release the ball.
Good release timing produces better Stuff.
changes.english:
Press <×> twice to pitch.
First press: start the delivery.
Second press: release the ball.
Good timing increases Pitch Power.

changes.source:
投球をはじめた時、そのまま投球開始ボタンを押
したままにしてみて下さい。
投球カーソルが段々大きくなり赤くなります。
この全力ピッチをすると、スタミナと制球を失う
代わりに球威の高い球を投げられます。
changes.previous_english:
Keep holding the pitch-start button as the
delivery begins. The cursor grows and turns
red, charging a Power Pitch. It adds Stuff
at the cost of Stamina and accuracy.
changes.english:
Hold the pitch-start button as the delivery
begins. The cursor grows and turns red.
This Power Pitch increases Pitch Power
at the cost of Stamina and Control.

mechanic_reviews: CPU swing preferences remain conditional on CPU control.
Pickoffs, reflexes, catcher blocks, bunt charging, first-base coverage and headfirst slides keep their specific positions/actions.
Clutch pitching/hitting use runners in scoring position, while Table Setter uses the bases empty.
Early-count Hitter applies before the first strike, not only the first pitch.
Two-strike Battler and Strikeout Prone apply with two strikes.
First-inning leadoff, pinch-hit, comeback, walk-off and bases-loaded effects preserve their distinct triggers.
Power Surge and Repeat Power trigger after a home run; Multi-hit Momentum triggers after two hits.
Pull Hitter and opposite-field control concern foul-ball tendency; All-fields Power concerns retained power.
Line Drive, Artist and Power Hitter retain the native angle/speed/spin distinctions.
Durability applies to Pennant injuries; seasonal form traits retain their different periods.
Pitch Power changes break timing, pitch-marker size and fastball deceleration; it is not just velocity.
Both pitcher and batter handedness affect the displayed pitch.
A Power Pitch increases Pitch Power at a cost to Stamina and Control.
Luck descriptions refer broadly to the team winning; do not assume the pitcher must receive the individual win credit.
Okawari as a player nickname is not the Power Surge ability.

source_label_description_discrepancies.issue: The native Pull Tendency label is paired with a description about disregarding team tactics. Keep the literal native description pending a mechanic audit.
The native Close Games label explicitly says performs better late when the game is NOT close. Do not reverse the source condition without native-mechanic evidence.
